GAMES-AD
========

This archive contains seven Aventuras AD games distributed with permission,
including Supervivencia: El Firfurcio. It includes the 8-bit versions now
supported by ADP.

Only files known to run with ADP are included. Some protected originals cannot
be loaded directly: those versions use a working snapshot or extracted DDB and
graphics files instead. Keep each DDB and its matching CDG file together.

Pass a tape, disk, snapshot, image or DDB file to the desktop player or DDB
tool. Multi-disk games need all the files in their platform folder.

These games remain the property of their respective authors and publishers.
They are included for preservation, testing and personal use; this archive
does not grant rights beyond the permissions already given by their owners.
